what: The declared restart budget: the widened band measurement's six (file, language) cells re-measured with the mapped set, streams, seeds, machinery, sweep cap, block split, plants, floors, band population and leave-one-out tables carried forward unchanged, and each machinery call's restart count raised from the inherited 16 to the declared 48, so every side searches three times the inherited depth under the same instrument. The bridge gate re-derived the frozen widened-band artifact's first cell through the inherited budget before the deeper cells ran. The declared truthful question: does the real's held-out score-half value still stand above the band when every machinery call draws three times the inherited restart budget. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.restarts_rule: the declared restart budget 48 per machinery call (one rank initialisation plus 47 seeded permutations), up from the inherited 16; the extra restarts continue each call's declared machinery kind's permutation stream, restarts 1 to 15 replaying the inherited budget's permutation draws exactly and restarts 16 to 47 drawing the next 32 permutations of the same stream at the same declared kind and position, consuming no new seed kind and no new position; every recorded inherited-budget value re-prices only if a later restart strictly beats the running best beyond 1e-12, ties to the first restart, so the first 16 restarts of every call are byte-identical replays of the frozen widened band's declared draws and only the restart budget's depth changes; deterministic, consuming no new seed
declared.convergence_rule: every machinery call records its restarts at full precision, the exact climb-half means for the held-out machinery and the exact full-data means for the full side machinery, and each call records a declared convergence lens, family 4's declared agree-to-within-0.0001 precision applied to the restarts' recorded means: a call's flag true when the distance between its best and its worst recorded restart is at most 0.0001 mean nats per pair. The flags are recorded facts; no verdict, margin, membership or exclusion depends on any flag, and band membership stays unconditional exactly as the held-out screen declared
declared.loo_rule: the shape measurement's leave-one-out table carried forward unchanged: the inherited add-one form is log((n_ab + 1) / (N + 729)) with N the standing reference stream's total counted pairs; every pair type (a, b) present in the reference pair table is scored with one occurrence of (a, b) removed from the reference counts, log(n_ab / (N + 728)), and a type with no counted occurrence keeps the inherited add-one entry log(1 / (N + 729)); the letter marginals and rank initialisation unchanged, the matrix arithmetic needing no re-derivation as the shape measurement declared
declared.split_rule: the block fold's split carried unchanged from the widened band: the counted pairs of each side, in stream order, split at the midpoint, the first floor(N/2) pairs the climb half the machinery may search and the remaining pairs the score half it may never touch; the split's ratio's 25/75 variant is not this measurement's split, and every identity anchor's halves fold by the standing block rule; deterministic, consuming no seed
declared.measured_facts_rule: the mapped set, streams, seeds, machinery, sweep cap, block split, plants, floors, band population and reference texts are the held-out screen's, block-fold measurement's and widened band's declarations carried unchanged; every machinery call climbs the declared 48 restarts by continuing the frozen widened-band draws' permutation streams, so only the restart budget's depth changes and every recorded inherited-budget value re-prices only on strict improvement beyond 1e-12, ties to the first restart; the per-restart recording is new to this artifact at full precision and each call's exact full-data side call stays recorded beside its held-out value for attribution only
declared.machinery_rule: unchanged from the held-out screen, recorded: the exact greedy reassignment climb on the climb half, exact pricing on the score half, restart 0 the rank initialisation from the climb half, restarts 1 to 47 the seeded permutations of the 27 letter tokens under the wrap rule, the best restart the best exact climb-half total with ties to the first; every restart's exact total recorded; no assignment is stored
declared.seed_sharing: no new seed kinds are consumed: the real, plants, floors and band members replay the declared draws from the declared kinds at the declared positions exactly as the frozen widened band consumed them, the extra restarts drawing continuations of the same machinery streams, the split consuming no seed; consuming none of any other module's declared draws
declared.bridge_gate: before the deeper cells run, the restart-budget instrument's full first cell (ZL english: the real, its five plants, its five floors and its seven widened band members) is computed through this measurement's code with the inherited 16 restarts supplied and every call's restarts recorded, and compared field for field against the frozen widened-band artifact's own first cell; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.corpus_source_rule: no new corpus files: this measurement declares no candidates and records no corpus roster; the band population is the frozen widened band's declared roster and the references are the standing references' frozen files, all stored raw with their Gutenberg markers and processed by the standing declared processing
declared.band_record_rule: membership, selection, ties and spreads are declared unchanged from the held-out screen (a member's band value the held-out value of the draw whose exact climb-half total is best, strict beyond 1e-12, ties to the first draw); each member records draws_climb_exact, its five climb-half totals at full precision, now the best of each draw's 48 recorded restarts, every draw's restart totals at full precision and every draw's convergence flag; membership unconditional: every band member enters the band under the declared restart budget exactly as under the inherited budget and no convergence criterion is applied to any member
declared.verdict_rule: unchanged from the held-out screen and applied to the restart-budget numbers: the real held-out at or above the smallest member band value is consistent-with-substitution, at or below the largest floor's held-out value is not-consistent, strictly between is below-held-band; the strings describe consistency under this artifact's declared restart budget and do not restate the widened band's verdicts
declared.margin_rule: the margin is computed from the stored rounded values: the real held-out mean minus the smallest member band value, rounded to four decimals
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so a restart-budget verdict is search-depth evidence and the widened band's verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.truthful_question: declared in advance: does the real's held-out score-half value still stand above the band when every machinery call draws three times the inherited restart budget - a yes extends the separation to a deeper search, a no records that the margin rode the inherited budget's depth
